expect_red: planHighlight tints a bound face only where its part is open, and an unbound edge is a note, never an error

mutations.contract: A hover highlight tints only what is drawn: a binding on a part that is not open in the scene tints nothing.
mutations.note: Without the open check the scene is asked to tint a mesh it does not hold -- a silent no-op that still reports a highlighted face to the viewer.
